transcript:
[00:00] Is AMC stock about to explode?
[00:02] Common knowledge is that movie theaters are dead, a relic from before we had home theaters.
[00:06] But the explosive success of Obsession and Backrooms, now followed shortly by the Odyssey,
[00:11] has led to AMC posting their most profitable quarter in its 106-year history.
[00:17] If you remember, AMC was one of the main darlings of the meme stock craze of 2021,
[00:21] reaching an all-time high of nearly $400.
[00:24] Though the stock has been heavily diluted since,
[00:26] It trades at less than 1% of the prior all-time high, at $2.25.
[00:32] Not even enough to buy popcorn.
[00:33] But if this success continues, AMC could at least run up to the prior range high from August 2023,
[00:38] which would still be nearly a 6x.
[00:41] And of course, if this thing goes full meme stock mania, well, you never know what could happen.
[00:45] It seems that people are craving IRL experiences, and AMC might be one of the big beneficiaries.
[00:50] And when you sprinkle in some of that meme stock magic, you just never really know.
[00:53] So to be honest, I think it's worth a tiny punt.
[00:54] But certainly this is not something you would go all in on.
